Record Class Ray.Intersection<T>

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
net.minestom.server.collision.Ray.Intersection<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of object collided with
Record Components:
t - the distance along the ray that the intersection was found
point - the point of intersection
normal - the normal of the intersected surface
exitT - the distance along the ray that the ray exits the object
exitPoint - the point from which the ray exits the object
exitNormal - the normal of the surface through which the ray exits
object - the object collided with
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Ray.Intersection<?>>
Enclosing class:
Ray
public static record Ray.Intersection<T>(double t, Point point, Vec normal, double exitT, Point exitPoint, Vec exitNormal, T object) extends Record implements Comparable<Ray.Intersection<?>>
An intersection found between a Ray and object of type T.

    • compareTo

      public int compareTo(Ray.Intersection<?> o)
      Compares this intersection's t value with that of another one. If they are equal, compares their exitT values.
      Specified by:
      compareTo in interface Comparable<T>
      Parameters:
      o - Any other intersection
      Returns:
      a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer as this object is less than, equal to, or greater than the specified object.

    • overlaps

      public boolean overlaps(Ray.Intersection<?> other)
      Returns whether an intersection overlaps with another; if one's exitT is less than or equal to the other's t.

      Use this to validate before using merge(Intersection).

      Parameters:
      other - the other intersection
      Returns:
      whether the intersections overlap

    • merge

      public Ray.Intersection<T> merge(Ray.Intersection<?> other)
      Merges two intersections by making one out of the lowest t and highest exitT from the intersections.
      Parameters:
      other - the other intersection
      Returns:
      a potentially larger intersection with the same object as this

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
